scope: Independent whole-book proof binds explicit bibliography, full source/extraction, all directory identities/order and complete evidence-page hashes. Publication year and course standard year are separate.
Old523 source locators cannot inherit a new proof. Same-name originals remain explicit editor-only references; post-I/O current-editor checks and no-write reference reads are exercised.
One actual27-numbered-lesson/51-entry original is independently registered with unknown publication/standard years; the old26-lesson revision stays unqualified and student choices are not switched.

New source snapshots/commands carry the proof hash. Changed qualification blocks new preflight/publication/create/upgrade after I/O while original commands, receipts, adopted history and learner first responses remain frozen.
Synchronous catalog projections share one inventory; caches end before any await and subsequent exact-source checks reread actual file bytes.
limitations: This is an isolated engineering candidate, not a main application merge or release.
Only one real whole-book directory and the first physical7-9 lesson source are reviewed here, not all textbook bodies or complete teaching content.
The exact edition record does not grant redistribution rights, mapping approval, teacher review or real learning effectiveness.
First47-test batch44/3 and existing diagnostic27/8 failures are retained; batch results are independent and never summed.
